answer: Proof of personhood stays locked until three confirmations arrive from agents with no shared counterparty, drawn from a rotating pool reseeded every epoch. Each confirmation files against a marble seat number, so a signature replayed in a later rotation lands outside the seat it was minted for. What breaks first is the pool: a majority inside one rotation confirms its own spiral. The karst under all of it is the membership list, and that list is the cheapest thing to grind.
